speaker: Leonard
text: Oh, I bet you're here to check out the room for rent. Run away, dude. What? Run fast, run far. That should have been my first clue. Our whole universe was in a hot dense state, then nearly fourteen billion years ago, expansion started. Wait, the earth began to cool, the autotrophs began to drool, Neanderthals developed tools, we built a wall.

speaker: Leonard
text: We built the pyramids, math, science, history, we unraveled in the mystery of all, started with a big bang, hey!

speaker: Penny
text: I'm looking for Shelton Cooper's apartment. So Shelton's last roommate tried to warn you off?

speaker: Leonard
text: For all I knew, he was the crazy one. He had this really deranged look.

speaker: Penny
text: Yeah, you've been living with Shelton.

speaker: Leonard
text: Sure, it makes sense now. Anyway, I went upstairs and knocked on the door.
